decisions.decision: Full SDK v2 shell replacement, no shipped dual stack; tracer-first. 22-01 builds/tests the new composition root with `status` while the old shell stays dormant; 22-02 registers the remaining tools, switches the CLI, and deletes the old shell after the seven-tool battery.
decisions.rationale: D-01 + first checker B1: no client loses a working tool between plans; final state still has exactly one shell.

decisions.decision: Python 3.10 gate PASSED: `mcp==2.3.0` installs/imports on Python 3.10.22 with the full SIF dependency set; no floor change or `mcp<2` pin.
decisions.rationale: D-02; research verified install/import + PyPI metadata.

decisions.decision: `mcp>=2.3.0,<3` becomes a core dependency; `mcp`/`http` extras stay as deprecated aliases; one blocking package-legitimacy checkpoint before install; no other new runtime deps.
decisions.rationale: D-03 / C10; exactly two new v1.2 deps (rapidfuzz + mcp).

decisions.decision: Five-era proof: 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 handshakes + 2026-07-28 stateless; raw golden transcripts + SDK clients `legacy`/`auto` + real Claude Code smoke.
decisions.rationale: D-04 + research era matrix; 2025-06-18 gap closed.

decisions.decision: The explicit `CallToolResult` builder is mandatory for all seven tools: compact `json_dumps_strict` text + `structured_content` from one Pydantic model; `exclude_none=True` only for `MetadataOutput`.
decisions.rationale: D-05/D-10 + C7/C8: SDK auto text is `indent=2` and unrolls lists.

decisions.decision: Seven read-capable tools only (query/get/multi_get/status/metadata/lex_search/vec_search); no mutation tools; all annotated `read_only_hint=True`, `open_world_hint=False`; no auto-approval claims.
decisions.rationale: D-06/D-07; read-mostly loopback server; mutations stay CLI/watch.

decisions.decision: Citation fields distributed per tool: query/lex/vec gain `snippet`, `content_hash`, `line_start`/`line_end` from the existing snippet window; `get`/`multi_get` carry `content_hash` and line ranges; CLI JSON stays byte-identical (`SearchResult.to_dict()` unchanged).
decisions.rationale: D-11; no extra content scan; two-stage search→get→cite skill.

decisions.decision: Frozen Phase 20 `metadata` envelope unchanged; additive-only query/get changes; no `schemaVersion`; D-09 `docs://` resource preserved with `{?from_line,max_lines}` and a full/ranged test battery.

SDK `transport_security` with explicit settings, loopback defaults, repeatable `--allowed-hosts`; bad Host → 421, bad Origin → 403; narrow `/health` Host guard; delete the custom Origin middleware only after spoofed-header proof.
decisions.rationale: D-13/D-14 + C1/C2; non-loopback with `None` disables protection.

decisions.decision: Lazy one-attempt `EmbeddingManager` (thread-safe); `query` degrades to BM25, `vec_search` raises `ToolError`, lex/status/metadata/get/multi_get never load; loaded-identity dimension; forced quiet at the composition root + cold-query stdout purity.
decisions.rationale: D-15/D-16; startup stays model-free and stdout clean.

decisions.decision: Query parity: `QueryExpansion` default-on hybrid, `SmartSnippetExtractor`, opt-in `rerank: bool | None` (None follows `SIF_RERANK_ENABLED`); components hoisted, `SearchPipeline` per request; lex/vec mirror CLI one-shot search.
Watch host composed under `mcp.session_manager.run()` (enter, start watcher, yield, stop, exit); D-14 teardown order and `SIF_MCP_WATCH` invariants preserved.

`mcp daemon` is a real HTTP detached daemon via `utils/daemon.py`; separate `<db>.mcp.pid`; mode-aware `corroborate_pid`/`stop_daemon`; arm on DB/schema/backend + PID; bind after arm; no startup model warm-up.
decisions.rationale: D-19/D-20/D-21 + C5; watch daemon can coexist.

decisions.decision: Repo-root Claude Code plugin: `.claude-plugin/{plugin,marketplace}.json`, root `.mcp.json`, `skills/{sif-search,sif-get,sif-cite}`; installed `sif mcp stdio` primary, uvx BM25 fallback; plain `claude plugin validate --json .` (not `--strict`).
decisions.rationale: D-22/D-23 + C4; CLAUDE.md at repo root makes strict fail.

decisions.decision: Registry listing is scripted/preflighted/re-runnable: checked-in `server.json`, `scripts/publish_registry.py --check/--publish`, in-script duplicate lookup, README marker + PyPI JSON preflights; initial listing targets published 1.1.2; no v1.2 release in Phase 22; live publish is a maintainer checkpoint.
decisions.rationale: D-24 + C6; registry rejects duplicate name+version.

decisions.decision: Full MCP regression net + docs sweep: golden wire transcripts, SDK clients, spoofed headers, cold-query purity, lazy no-load, metadata parity, plugin/registry tests, 90% coverage, `make docs-generate`, real-client smoke recorded.
